protocol.statistic: median of the timed frames of a repetition; the whole run (every engine) repeated, and the figure is the median of the repetitions' medians, with their spread (max - min) / median
protocol.timed: from the engine's first call until its output is complete; the clear to the background is not timed
protocol.build: shape-cpu: recording the list from resources interned once; Blend2D and Skia draw immediately and have no build step
protocol.cold: the first frame on an engine with nothing cached (shape-cpu's expansion cache of the strokes empty), one frame a repetition, before the warm-up; the scene arm's is the first frame of its process, the picture's-own-list arm's follows that process's render of the picture (code and memory warm, the sink new)
protocol.target: caller-owned 8-bit RGBA premultiplied (Blend2D: BGRA in memory, its PRGB32), source-over, no dithering
protocol.reference_picture: shape-cpu's own picture, the PNG of the list as recorded (not the scene arm's frame)
protocol.pixel_measure: largest difference over R, G and B of the pixel; share of the pixels past each threshold
protocol.limits: one run on one machine; there is no speed threshold (AD-28)

differences: 8 of 14 groups composite in linear light in shape-cpu's picture (the colour-glyph lowering's choice); Blend2D and Skia composite every group in the target's encoded values, so where translucent layers overlap in those groups the pixels differ by construction
Blend2D has no hue, saturation, color or luminosity operator: 1 hue group drawn source-over there; Skia draws them
2 clips to a glyph outline: Skia clips to the path; Blend2D clips to rectangles only, so each is a layer multiplied by the coverage of the path (a different antialiasing of the clip's edge)
1 sweep gradient over part of a turn: Skia states them; Blend2D's conic gradient spans whole turns, so its color line is sampled into stops over one turn (the scene's seam, folds and jumps included)
1 radial gradient with a start circle of nonzero radius (a two-circle cone): shape-cpu and Skia state it; Blend2D through its start radius

1 dashed stroke: this Blend2D draws a dash array solid, through the context and through BLPath::add_stroked_path alike (the dash array in BLStrokeOptions), so its picture has solid strokes where shape-cpu and Skia (SkDashPathEffect) have dashes, and its time is for solid strokes
Gradients are interpolated in the target's encoded values straight; a gradient shape-cpu interpolates in linear light is sampled into 16 encoded stops in the scene (the nearest the references have)

Text is the outlines of the font library's own outline provider drawn as paths by Blend2D, Skia and, in the scene arm, shape-cpu: shaping, outline loading and glyph caches are not timed. Skia's and Blend2D's antialiasing and curve flattening are their own
A solid color is rounded to 8 bits and a gradient's stops to 8 bits in the scene; a group's opacity and a gradient's alpha multiplier are carried exactly (opacity) or to 8 bits (alpha)
SVG 2 joins: 1 miter-clip and 1 arcs. Blend2D has miter-clip (BL_STROKE_JOIN_MITER_CLIP) and no arcs (drawn miter-bevel); Skia has neither (both drawn as its miter, a bevel past the limit)
